documented_facts.scope: Perimeters of forest fires in the Comunitat Valenciana, 1993-2024, for informative and non-binding use; not every fire in the period is mapped.
documented_facts.statistical_precedence: The official fire report prevails over the cartography in case of discrepancy, except for error or omission.

lineage.method: GPS data positioned using the ICV CV10 series.
Remote-sensing analysis, mainly IRS/LISS imagery at 20 m, positioned using ICV CV10.
Remote-sensing analysis using IRS-P6/LISS-III and ICV terrain, orthophoto and CV10 reference products; the metadata includes year-specific acquisition notes.
Remote-sensing analysis using Landsat and, for 2009-2010, SPOT imagery, with ICV reference products.
Homogenisation and preparation for web publication from each year's shapefiles and fire statistics, including statistical attributes and fire-report identifiers.
The former numparte field was replaced by separate autonomous-community and ministry report identifiers.

documented_facts.attribution_and_redistribution_note: The ICV terms require visible source attribution and state that recipients of redistributed information must expressly accept the terms of use.

duplicate_geometry_explanation.finding: The reviewed official metadata describes acquisition, homogenisation and publication processes but does not explain why identical coordinates may occur under different fire identifiers or in different annual layers.
duplicate_geometry_explanation.allowed_inference: The annual layers were produced from annual shapefiles and statistical records, but this alone does not establish that repeated coordinates are republications, placeholders, separate events or data errors.

topology_adapter_crosscheck.purpose: Three preliminary hole-assignment anomalies were checked against GeoJSON generated by the same official ArcGIS service. This exposed and corrected a point-based hole-assignment error in the audit adapter.
topology_adapter_crosscheck.result: All three official GeoJSON responses and the corrected local Esri-ring interpretation are OGC valid.
